Peter Kropotkin, Memoirs of a Revolutionist.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/peter-kropotkin/memoirs-of-a-revolutionist

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Peter Kropotkin, the author and the writer of a preface, died 1921 (Wikidata Q5752, P570 = 1921-02-08; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Kropotkin).

First publication of the text used: 'Memoirs of a Revolutionist was published in 1899 by Peter Kropotkin.' (SE colophon).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1899, before 1929. Works published before 1929 entered the United States public domain by 1 January 2025, and Standard Ebooks states the same in its rights statement (below).
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1921 or earlier; the last to die was Peter Kropotkin in 1921 (Wikidata Q5752, P570 = 1921-02-08). So the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
